items.description: A searchable user list with pagination in the URL, a shared add and edit form and row actions.

Users.add_user_description: Sends a real POST request to the DummyJSON demo API.
Users.add_not_saved: This user was not saved. DummyJSON is a demo API: it returns the new user but does not store it, so the user will not appear in the list.
Users.no_users_description: The API returned an empty list.
Users.validation_username_format: Use letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores
Users.details_description: Shows the data already in the table, with no request.
Users.edit_description: Sends a real PUT request to the DummyJSON demo API. It stores nothing, so the change lasts until the list loads again.
Users.delete_description: Sends a real DELETE request to the DummyJSON demo API. It stores nothing, so the user comes back when the list loads again.

Users.add_user_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine gerçek bir POST isteği gönderir.

Users.error_network: İstek gönderilemedi. İnternet bağlantını kontrol et.
Users.validation_username_format: Harf, rakam, nokta, tire veya alt çizgi kullan
Users.edit_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine gerçek bir PUT isteği atar. API hiçbir şey saklamaz; değişiklik liste yeniden yüklenene kadar kalır.
Users.delete_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine gerçek bir DELETE isteği atar. API hiçbir şey saklamaz; kullanıcı liste yeniden yüklenince geri gelir.
